status: Written before any feature, score or outcome of either holdout set was computed. HA's aggregate LEAD EV (+3.2%, n=222) is public in docs/04; nothing per launch or per rule had been looked at. HB's tapes had not been pulled (only the create index, create decodes and the chain-only multi-wallet prescreen).

sets.HA: critic holdout (data/cache/strategy_holdout, Oct 14 08:43-13:43 UTC): random-group multi-wallet launches with a complete tape; never used by G1/G2/G3
sets.HB: new dense block (data/cache/strategy_holdout2): every eligible create (non-mayhem, SOL-quoted, single create, < 84.9 SOL in the create tx, mint in no earlier cache) from anchor-45 min backwards, newest first, multi-wallet by the chain-only prescreen (getSignaturesForAddress + slot-0 txs, tapes._raw_bundle's rule), tapes from swap-api (25 s x1 page, then 4 s x1, then 4 s x4), until 500 swap-api requests (retries included) are spent; final multi-wallet status from build_tape

primary.what: G1 frozen rule 3 P(TP) (predictor_frozen_models.pkl, unchanged), keep score >= t2 (top tertile)
primary.test: EV(kept) - EV(all) on the same launches

primary.what: G1 frozen rule 3, keep score >= t1 (skip the bottom tertile; G1's probe recommendation)
mdl:rand:all:gbt_3:tp:keep0.2 refitted on the whole table (frozen here)
mdl:pool:all:lr_0.5:ret:keep0.4 refitted on the whole table (frozen here)
gate s+0 p>=5% k>=5 pass:tp50+trail15+idle2+cap5 fail:scalp

primary.test: SOL per SOL deployed minus a flat stake of the same mean size

primary.what: G2's pre-registration note: no third-party buy behind us by the end of slot 0 -> sell at the end of slot+1 (fire slot 0, 1-slot latency); else LEAD

secondary: sell at the end of slot+1 always
G1 frozen rules 1 (tx index <= 295) and 2 (n10 GBT top 40%)
HB only: the two retrained configs refitted again on table + HA (walk-forward step, same code)
stress of every rule: +3.6% premium, 0.01 SOL, 2-slot exit latency, rank 2, gap-2 median-bid-priced cost
g3: G3 has no positive screen (graduation, second wave, hour/create rate all lost); nothing to carry.
statistics: Pooled HA+HB. One-sided p from a bootstrap over signers (clusters), 4000 draws; BH over the 8 primary tests. A rule 'raises the edge beyond the LEAD on fresh data' only if its pooled lift > 0 with BH q < 0.10 and the lift is >= 0 on both HA and HB. Per set and per stress reported regardless.
volume: trades/day = qualifying launches/day x kept share x landing rate; qualifying launches/day both 3,750 (docs/04) and 6,181 (G3 pnl_model); SOL/day from pnl_model at L1 = 20%, c_fail 0.003, f_pay 0.8, reach 0.93
